naturality.config.liquids.waterDepth.too: Clear shallows, dark depths and a visible surface overhead. Local lights remain visible. Swamps are murky.
naturality.config.liquids.waterDistortio: World-aligned refraction above water grows with depth. Coarse underwater distortion fades out nearby.
naturality.config.liquids.waterShimmer.t: Project bright areas of the live water pattern onto exposed seafloor tops. Fades with depth, shade and weather.
naturality.config.liquids.water.tooltip: Use live procedural textures for still and flowing water. OFF restores the active resource pack's water sprites. Applies immediately.
naturality.config.liquids.lava.tooltip: Use live procedural lava textures. OFF restores both lava sprites from the active resource pack. Applies immediately.
naturality.config.liquids.flowingLava.to: Use the directional procedural sprite for flowing lava when Lava changes is ON. OFF uses the active resource pack's flowing lava sprite while keeping custom still lava.
naturality.config.hardcoreDarkness.caves: Master toggle for removing ambient light and darkening cave fog in enabled dimensions. OFF restores normal ambient lighting. Independent of moon darkness. Default: ON.
Normal ambient light retained in enabled dimensions: 0% makes unlit caves pitch black; 100% keeps normal ambient light. Torches and night vision still work. Default: 0%.
Fade cave haze with local light so fog does not reveal dark terrain. Follows retained ambient light in enabled dimensions; excludes lava and powder snow. Default: ON.
naturality.config.hardcoreDarkness.dimen: Enable this page's darkness effect in the Overworld. Default: ON.
Enable this page's darkness effect in the Nether. Moon darkness uses the Overworld day and moon cycle where there is no moving sun. Default: OFF.
Enable this page's darkness effect in the End. Moon darkness uses the Overworld day and moon cycle where there is no moving sun. Default: OFF.
Enable this page's darkness effect in custom dimensions. Uses their sun/moon when available, otherwise the Overworld cycle. Default: OFF.
Master toggle for moon-dependent skylight, sky and cloud darkening. OFF restores normal moon-independent brightness, without changing cave darkness. Default: ON.
Night skylight retained during a full moon. 0% is no moonlight; 100% is normal night skylight. Does not dim the moon or stars. Default: 100%.
Night skylight retained for waxing and waning gibbous moons. Also scales sky/clouds when their toggles are ON. Default: 75%.
Night skylight retained for first and third quarter moons. Also scales sky/clouds when their toggles are ON. Default: 50%.
Night skylight retained for waxing and waning crescent moons. Also scales sky/clouds when their toggles are ON. Default: 25%.
Night skylight retained during a new moon. At 0%, enable Cave darkness with 0% ambient light for pitch-black unlit terrain. Moon and stars retain normal brightness. Default: 0%.
Apply phase brightness to the sky background and horizon fog. The sun, moon and stars keep their normal brightness. Default: ON.
Apply phase brightness to both Naturality cloud layers and vanilla clouds. Daylight remains unchanged. Default: ON.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.subBlo: Keep fractional hand/entity positions with 1/16-light-level precision. Respects walls and the existing surface pixel grid. Costs more CPU work; OFF restores block-snapped sources. Default: ON.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.enable: Moving light sources illuminate the client world. Disabling removes their light. Does not affect server gameplay or mob spawning.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.update: 50-1000 ms at 20 ticks/second. Lower values follow movement faster but require more lighting and chunk updates. Default: 100 ms.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.bright: Scales emitted light levels; capped at Minecraft's maximum level 15. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.source: Only track sources within this distance from the camera. This is a performance limit, not each light's radius. Default: 48 blocks.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.maxSou: Track the nearest light source cells first. Lower this if moving lights cause chunk rebuild stutter. Default: 64.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.heldIt: Light-emitting items in either hand of players and mobs illuminate nearby blocks, starting near the hand.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.emissi: Blazes, glow squid, magma cubes, allays, vexes, wardens, glow frames and faint emissive eyes. Entity light levels can be customized by ID in the JSON config.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.burnin: Entities on fire emit level 15 light.
naturality.config.dynamicLighting.droppe: Dropped torches, lanterns and other supported luminous items emit light until picked up or removed.
naturality.config.title: Naturality settings
naturality.config.reset.tooltip: Reset this setting to its default value.
naturality.config.fog.enabled.tooltip: OFF restores vanilla fog. ON enables pixelated borders, an End sky fade and an Overworld atmosphere fade that hides the sun, moon and stars behind terrain. Applies when leaving this page.
naturality.config.fog.pixelSize.tooltip: Size in screen pixels, from 1×1 to 32×32. Smaller means finer resolution; larger means chunkier squares. Default: 4×4. Applies when leaving this page.
naturality.config.lighting.darkStep.tool: Approximate brightness gap in deep shadows. Smaller values give finer bands. Range: 0.1–10%. Applies on closing settings.
naturality.config.lighting.lightStep.too: Approximate brightness gap near full light. Range: 0.1–10%. Cannot be lower than the dark step; equal values give uniform steps.
naturality.config.lighting.aoStep.toolti: Independent AO shading gap. Range: 0.1–5%. Default: 0.5%. The block grid stays 16×16.
naturality.config.lighting.darkSaturatio: Maximum extra saturation as lighting darkens. 0% disables the boost. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.lighting.saturationSta: Lighting level below which the saturation boost smoothly eases in. Default: 30%. Higher values include brighter areas.
naturality.config.lighting.saturationFul: Lighting level at which the full boost is reached. Default: 10%. Must remain at least 1% below the start level; adjusted when saved.
naturality.config.intro.tooltip: Controls new portal openings in your singleplayer/LAN worlds. OFF restores instant ignition; physical crossing still controls travel. Remote servers control this in naturality-server.json. Openings already in progress finish normally.
naturality.config.clouds.enabled.tooltip: Two customizable cloud layers. Off restores vanilla clouds. Minecraft Clouds: Off still hides all clouds.
naturality.config.clouds.base.style.tool: With fading enabled, volumetric clouds adapt their caps and gradient to camera height. Without fading, Open shell has no lid and Solid keeps both caps. Flat has no sides.
naturality.config.clouds.base.fadingSide: Adapt the pixel gradient and top/bottom caps to camera height, with uniform face color. Day/night tint remains. Off restores directional shading. Flat is unaffected.
naturality.config.clouds.base.width.tool: Width in blocks of each cloud texture cell. Default: 12.
Cloud thickness in blocks. Has no effect on Flat style.
naturality.config.clouds.base.heightOffs: Blocks above or below the dimension's normal cloud height. Upper layer defaults to +40.
naturality.config.clouds.base.fadePixels: Number of square pixel rows along the side. Fewer rows make larger pixels.
naturality.config.clouds.base.speedPerce: 100% = vanilla speed; 0 = stationary; negative values reverse direction.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.style.too: With fading enabled, volumetric clouds adapt their caps and gradient to camera height. Without fading, Open shell has no lid and Solid keeps both caps. Flat has no sides.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.fadingSid: Adapt the pixel gradient and top/bottom caps to camera height, with uniform face color. Day/night tint remains. Off restores directional shading. Flat is unaffected.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.width.too: Width in blocks of each cloud texture cell. Default: 12.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.thickness: Cloud thickness in blocks. Has no effect on Flat style.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.heightOff: Blocks above or below the dimension's normal cloud height. Upper layer defaults to +40.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.fadePixel: Number of square pixel rows along the side. Fewer rows make larger pixels.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.speedPerc: 100% = vanilla speed; 0 = stationary; negative values reverse direction.
naturality.config.lighting.enabled.toolt: Enable the terrain lighting grid, brightness bands and shadow saturation. Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.fog.densitySteps.toolt: Number of density bands in pixel fog (2–64). Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.effects.sunBeams.toolt: Show the rotating pixelated rays around the sun.
naturality.config.effects.starPulses.too: Animate star brightness and size. Off keeps static stars. Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.effects.auroraSegments: Number of flat planes used for each 256-block aurora curve span. Lower values create a more angular, low-poly aurora.
naturality.config.effects.smoke.tooltip: Use swirling, expanding smoke. Off uses vanilla motion for new particles; resource-pack sprites remain.
naturality.config.effects.flames.tooltip: Use upright, constant-size animated flames. Off uses vanilla behavior for new particles; resource-pack sprites remain.
naturality.config.effects.leaves.tooltip: Use world-oriented falling leaves that rest on surfaces. Off restores vanilla leaf behavior.
Time on the ground before a ten-tick fade. 20 ticks = 1 second. Requires tumbling and resting leaves.
Vary animation by position and join connected wall textures. Off uses the original repeating exemplar animation on fitted surfaces. Applies when leaving this screen.
Join adjacent wall-fire textures. Requires fire texture variation. Applies when leaving this screen. Surface fitting and server contact behavior are unchanged.
naturality.config.portal.endParallax.too: Show spatial star layers behind End portals. Off restores projected layers. Applies when leaving this screen.
naturality.config.portal.endWalls.toolti: Fade neighboring block textures into End portal openings.
naturality.config.portal.endGlow.tooltip: Show End portal glow strips. Also requires Glow effect.
naturality.config.portal.eyeGlow.tooltip: Replace the insertion smoke puff with a fading glow. Off restores the puff.
naturality.config.portal.suppressEndSmok: Suppress ambient smoke from active End portals.
naturality.config.liquids.waterRim.toolt: Show a pixel rim around models crossing water and cauldron surfaces. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.rainRipples.to: Show rain impact rings on exposed water and cauldrons. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.waterfallParti: Small and large spray where falling or sloping water reaches flat resting water. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.dripRipples.to: Show rings where falling water particles land. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.fog.borderStartPercent: Fog density where pixelation starts. Must stay below full strength; clamped on save.
Fog density where pixelation reaches full strength. Must stay above the start; clamped on save.
Fit fire visuals, selection and burn contact to supporting shapes, allowing partial supports. Off restores vanilla geometry and placement. Server-owned; synced to connected clients.
naturality.config.gameplay.vanillaPortal: On restores vanilla portal waiting time, arrival, cooldown and entry overlay. Off uses physical crossing. Portal intro remains independent. Server-owned; synced to connected clients.
naturality.config.effects.snowOverlays.t: Add snow-colored patches to covered support faces. Requires the server to enable Snow wrapping.
naturality.config.effects.weatherParticl: Replace vanilla precipitation sheets with particle clusters.
naturality.config.effects.foliageWind.to: Animate exposed foliage in the wind.
naturality.config.effects.particleWind.t: Let wind move exposed smoke, leaves and other eligible particles.
naturality.config.effects.windSounds.too: Play weak and strong wind ambience.
naturality.config.effects.pixelGlint.too: Use the animated pixel grid instead of the vanilla glint texture.
naturality.config.effects.worldGlintCont: Outline enchanted world items, item frames and equipment on living entities.
naturality.config.effects.handGlintConto: Outline enchanted items in first-person hands.
naturality.config.effects.previewGlintCo: Outline enchanted equipment in inventory player portraits.
Fit snow placement, collision and selection to supporting shapes. Off restores vanilla snow behavior. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.gameplay.snowCompactio: Walking and landing compress snow layers, preserving the last layer. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.gameplay.weatherThaw.t: Warm weather gradually melts exposed snow and ice. Off keeps vanilla melting rules. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.gameplay.weatherSnowAc: Use rain strength to set natural snow accumulation limits. Off uses the vanilla gamerule. Controlled by the server.
naturality.config.liquids.waterParticleT: Tint water droplets, bubbles and splashes using the local biome. Requires Water changes.
naturality.config.liquids.waterWake.tool: Keep a short wake behind moving entities. Requires Water rims.
naturality.config.liquids.waterImpactCol: Show a splash column when entities fall more than five blocks into water.
naturality.config.liquids.waterSplashSou: Play the added splash sound for large falls into water.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaRim.toolti: Draw a rim where entities meet the lava surface.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaWake.toolt: Keep a short wake behind moving entities. Requires Lava rims.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaRainRipple: Show small smoke where rain hits lava.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaDripRipple: Show rings where droplets hit lava.
naturality.config.liquids.lavafallPartic: Show spray and droplets around falling lava.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaImpactColu: Show a splash column when entities fall into lava.
naturality.config.liquids.waterFallDropl: Show ballistic droplets at the foot of waterfalls. Requires Waterfall particles.
naturality.config.liquids.lavaFallDrople: Show ballistic droplets at the foot of lavafalls. Requires Lavafall spray.
naturality.config.effects.floatingLeaves: Let falling leaves rest and drift on water. Requires Leaf changes.
naturality.config.effects.rainSplashFade: Fade ground rain droplets before they land.
naturality.config.effects.bubblePops.too: Play a bubble-pop animation when bubble particles expire.
naturality.config.effects.fixedBubbleSca: Give bubble sprite variants a consistent pixel scale. Off restores vanilla random sizing.
naturality.config.liquids.emissiveLava.t: Keep lava sides as bright as the top, bypassing environmental shading.
naturality.config.clouds.base.opacityPer: Base cloud opacity, from 0% (hidden) to 100% (opaque). Side gradients, camera-height transitions and distance fading still apply. Default: 100%.
naturality.config.clouds.upper.opacityPe: Base cloud opacity, from 0% (hidden) to 100% (opaque). Side gradients, camera-height transitions and distance fading still apply. Default: 100%.
